The '''Luau Skirt''' is a pants item that can be purchased from the [[Island Trader]] for 50 [[Taro Root]]s. It is one of only two pants items that cannot be [[Tailoring#Pants|tailored]]. It also cannot be [[Dyeing|dyed]].
